title: E-Commerce Platform
description: Full-stack e-commerce platform with React, Node.js, and MongoDB. Features include user authentication, product catalog, shopping cart, payment processing with Stripe, order management, admin dashboard, and real-time notifications.

title: Social Media Dashboard
description: Real-time analytics dashboard for social media management. Tracks engagement metrics, follower growth, post performance, and sentiment analysis across multiple platforms.

title: Task Management System
description: Collaborative project management tool with Kanban boards, Gantt charts, time tracking, and team collaboration features. Supports agile methodologies with sprint planning.

title: AI Content Generator
description: Machine learning powered content generation tool using OpenAI GPT-4. Generates blog posts, social media content, marketing copy, and SEO-optimized articles.

title: Healthcare Portal
description: HIPAA-compliant patient management portal with appointment scheduling, telehealth integration, electronic health records, prescription management, and billing system.

title: Real Estate Marketplace
description: Property listing platform with virtual tours, mortgage calculator, property comparison, agent profiles, and neighborhood analytics with interactive maps.

title: Learning Management System
description: Online education platform with course creation tools, video streaming, interactive quizzes, progress tracking, certification management, and discussion forums.

title: Financial Portfolio Tracker
description: Personal finance management application with investment tracking, portfolio optimization, tax calculation, expense categorization, and financial goal planning.

title: IoT Device Manager
description: Centralized IoT device management platform with real-time monitoring, firmware updates, device configuration, telemetry data visualization, and alert management.

title: Video Conferencing App
description: WebRTC-based video conferencing application with screen sharing, chat, recording, virtual backgrounds, noise suppression, and meeting scheduling integration.
